<observations>
Date: Jul 15, 2026
* 🔴 (15:22) User profile: Graphic designer at downtown agency (WFH Thu/Fri), sleeps 7 hours/night, vegetarian (4+ years), takes evening magnesium. Manages a torn left knee meniscus. Prefers outdoor running, dislikes treadmills, refuses headphones on busy streets, bouncing waist packs, or neon apparel.
* 🟡 (14:00) Uses Garmin Forerunner 265 (HR 52 bpm) and Nike Pegasus shoes (45 miles).
* ✅ (20:05) Initial training check-in reminder scheduled.

Date: Jul 18, 2026
* 🔴 (09:00) Prefers coconut water over sports drinks, black coffee before long runs, and specific pre-workout meals (whole-wheat pasta / steel-cut oats).
* 🟢 (13:45) Discussed anti-chafing balms, dynamic warm-ups, and running in high humidity.
* ✅ (20:30) Weekly training schedule updated (28-mile goal).

Date: Jul 21, 2026
* 🟢 (11:45) Discussed trail shoe cleaning, uphill stride length, foam rolling, and post-run cold showers.
* ✅ (17:00) Daily recovery log updated.

Date: Jul 24, 2026
* 🔴 (12:10) Half marathon scheduled for September 4, 2026.
* 🟢 (15:30) Discussed electrolytes for hot weather, water bottle replacements, and swimming cross-training.
* ✅ (17:00) Weekly training schedule updated.

Date: Jul 28, 2026
* 🔴 (08:45) Prefers high-density foam rollers and compression socks; avoids bouncing waist packs.
* 🟢 (15:30) Discussed stationary cycling for recovery and gym duffel durability.
* ✅ (17:00) Weekly recovery schedule updated.

Date: Aug 1, 2026
* 🟢 (07:15) Discussed hamstring vs. quad stretching focus and hot-weather hydration temperatures.
* 🔴 (08:45) Dislikes static stretching before morning track sessions; refuses neon apparel on road runs.
* 🔴 (13:15) Drinks lemon-infused coconut water post-long runs; plans to buy a replacement running cap downtown tomorrow.
* 🟢 (15:30) Discussed swimming laps for upper-body cross-training.
* 🔴 (18:20) Stated they have never had a cardiac stress test.
* ✅ (17:00) Monthly training log updated with cross-training and nutrition notes.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Managing ongoing half-marathon training regimen (race date: September 4, 2026) while accommodating a torn left meniscus.
- Secondary: Tracking gear replacements (caps, foam rollers, water bottles) and monitoring recovery protocols.
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
The assistant should wait for the user to provide their next query or training update.
</suggested-response>
